recent.title: CRYPTOGRAPHIC SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PROVIDING SERVICES TO AUTHENTICATED USERS

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "khosla ventures", 2026-10-06

profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is an investor founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, United States. Its website describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence, and it describes backing efforts that leverage proprietary data and AI talent to build a finance workflow platform. The site also carries commentary on artificial intelligence, including the claim that AI will do 80% of the economically valuable work humans do today, for 80% of all jobs, and a comparison of AI to steam engines amplifying muscle power.

The material does not name specific portfolio companies or AI products, so no products are tracked for the firm. The site's stated position is that AI represents a difference in kind rather than degree, and it frames the technology as an expansion of brainpower serving humanity.

The record also notes a California law exposure count of 281. No lawsuits, no MCP servers, and no other products are listed.
